subject: general
question: Sheorinarayan fair is held in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sheorinarayan Fair,** a renowned festival in **Chhattisgarh**, takes place annually during February's Magh Purnima.
 
• It attracts a large gathering, both local and international, to the Sheorinarayan Temple dedicated to Lord Rama, the focal point of the festivities.
 
• This event showcases the vibrant cultural heritage and traditional festivals of Chhattisgarh.
 
• Throughout the festival, the Sheorinarayan Temple is adorned with intricate decorations of lights and flowers.
 
• The temple grounds transform into bustling marketplaces, offering a diverse array of traditional crafts to visitors from across India.
 
• The atmosphere is brimming with joyous celebrations, making it a memorable occasion for all attendees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhattisgarh **is a landlocked state located in Central India. 
 
• It is the ninth-largest state by area and the seventeenth most populous in India, with approximately 30 million residents. 
 
• Chhattisgarh shares its borders with seven other states: Uttar Pradesh to the north, Madhya Pradesh to the northwest, Maharashtra to the southwest, Jharkhand to the northeast, Odisha to the east, and Andhra Pradesh and Telangana to the south. 
 
• Formerly a part of Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh was granted statehood on 1 November 2000, with Raipur as its designated capital.
